expires_today.title: Create Magic with Magix
expires_today.long_description: Breeze through photo, musical, or video projects with professional‑quality tools by MAGIX. Unlock advanced video editing software built with precision and speed in mind with MAGIX Video Pro X16, easy music production with loops from every genre and a drag‑and‑drop workflow from Music Maker 2025 Premium, customize slideshows that turn photos into dynamic stories with Photostory deluxe 2025, and so much more! Turn bold ideas into powerful stories with the Create Magic with MAGIX Bundle, and help support Children's Miracle Network with your purchase!

expires_tomorrow.title: Gamer's Kitchen Cookbooks by Insight Editions
expires_tomorrow.description: Games have never looked so delicious
expires_tomorrow.long_description: Cook your way through your favorite games with this bundle of official and unofficial video game recipe books! Fry up tasty street food and mix some criminally delicious cocktails with An Unofficial Grand Theft Auto Cookbook! Fill up on sweetrolls and brew an apple cabbage stew any tavern keeper would envy with The Elder Scrolls: The Official Cookbook! Quench your thirst with the Wasteland-inspired libations in Fallout: The Official Drinks Book! Throw a gamer dinner party or cook up a multi-course meal for one with the 27 recipe books included in this collection! Grab them now at the price of your choice, and support NatureBridge with your purchase!

expires_tomorrow.title: Dungeon Adventures! - 3D Printable Miniatures & Scenery
expires_tomorrow.long_description: Your campaign is as real as you make it, so why not give it some life? Fill your dungeons with characters and scenery with this bundle of 3D printable miniatures from Hayland Terrain and Warp Miniatures! Get over 90 software files for absolutely everything you need—from giant ants and bats to rock elementals, spooky sewer entrances, tombs, market stalls, and more! Build your environments and fill them with characters, creatures, and tons of detail to give your players a whole world of adventure! Grab this bundle at the brice of your choice, and support Make-A-Wish with your purchase!

expires_tomorrow.title: POLY Game Dev Assets Collection #3
expires_tomorrow.long_description: Game developers, build your worlds easily and efficiently with our latest POLY Game Dev Asset Collection by Animpic Studio! Pay what you want for thousands of sharp assets from professional‑quality packs like POLY - Survival Subway, POLY - Survival Tower & Builder, and POLY - Fantasy House & Builder. These Unity and Unreal Engine‑compatible packs include FBX models, prefabs, materials, shaders, and multiple scene files. Create picture‑perfect polygon‑based assets without straining your team or wallet, and help support Save the Children with your purchase!

expires_tomorrow.title: Batman Day Comics Bundle by DC Comics
expires_tomorrow.long_description:
Own the night alongside the Caped Crusader with the Batman Day Comics Bundle 2026! Pay what you want for a catalog of modern classics by the biggest Batman artists and writers like Dan Watters, Scott Snyder, and Nick Dragotta. Read the Bat's action‑packed comics, including Batman: Dark Patterns, Batman Vol. 1–10 (2011–2016), and Absolute Batman Vol. 1: The Zoo. Bring your imagination and celebrate Batman Day on September 19th with the Dark Knight’s greatest adventures, and help support the BINC Foundation with your purchase!

Redeemed on GlobalComix. Keys expire. Please redeem and activate before October 10th, 2027. Titles are not available for download off of GlobalComix.
